response.text: Kubernetes is where I thrive! My flagship project was building a production-grade, highly available multi-master Kubernetes cluster on AWS. It includes a software-defined storage layer (Longhorn), zero-trust network model (Calico), and full disaster recovery (Velero). I successfully re-architected legacy stateful IBM applications as robust StatefulSets, proving they could run reliably in a modern cloud-native environment.
response.voiceText: Kubernetes is where I thrive! I've built production-grade, highly available clusters on AWS with zero-trust networking and full disaster recovery.

data.title: Enterprise K8s Infrastructure
data.description: A highly available, multi-master (3-node) Kubernetes cluster on AWS designed to simulate a secure on-premise environment for UBA Group's IBM workload validation.
achievements: Multi-master HA setup with 3 control plane nodes
